|game_text=Mace's game text may not be canceled (except at Senate) and he may fire one weapon twice per battle. [[Boba Fett (V) (Virtual Block 2){{!}}Boba Fett]] may not add battle destiny draws here. Immune to attrition.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Mace Windu (V) (Virtual Block 5)]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB5-44E-Mace_Windu-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026). The Virtual Block 5 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-44E-Mace_Windu.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-L-macewindu-pre.gif]]) show the original text; see [[Mace Windu (V) (Virtual Block 5)]].
* '''Original''' ([[Mace Windu (V) (Virtual Block 5)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 5 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Mace's game text may not be canceled (except at Senate). During battle, Mace may fire one weapon twice. Boba Fett may not add battle destiny draws here. Immune to attrition.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock5">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Mace Windu (V) (Virtual Block 5) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) changed “(except at Senate). During battle, Mace may fire one weapon twice.” to “(except at Senate) and he may fire one weapon twice per battle.”. The card list marks the entry “(Errata Text - September 9th, 2009)”. PC-E1 text: “Mace's game text may not be canceled (except at Senate) and he may fire one weapon twice per battle. Boba Fett may not add battle destiny draws here. Immune to attrition.”<ref name="cl-1250_45-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
